name: Zuclopenthixol
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text
dagger_note: † = general pharmacology; not in the SA guideline and not yet checked against the package insert
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: D1 and D2 receptor antagonist, acetate form acts for 2–3 days, decanoate is the depot

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Zuclopenthixol acetate, IM, 50–150 mg every 2–3 days (specialist/specialist consultation). · Start with 50mg in neuroleptic-naïve patients.
Zuclopenthixol decanoate, IM, 100–400 mg every 4 weeks. · Initial dose: 100mg
Zuclopenthixol decanoate, IM, 100 to 400 mg every 4 weeks. (Doctor prescribed.) · Initial dose: 100 mg.

cautions.t: Do not confuse the acetate (short-acting) with the decanoate (depot)

adverse_effects.t: Sedation, extrapyramidal effects, hypotension, neuroleptic malignant syndrome

monitoring.t: BP, level of sedation, extrapyramidal signs
